text:
maya: Heads-up — seeing a sudden spike of 500s from /generate in us-west around 20:10. Starting a short bridge to triage, join if you can: https://meet.redwood/bridge/8f4b2a :rotating_light:
liam: On my way, grabbing logs now. Which services to prioritize?
sandeep: I can watch KV cache and autoscaler metrics.
nora: Might be on my commute, can join in ~5.
maya: Thanks — quick agenda: 1) confirm scope (routes + customers affected) 2) check runtime and model-serving logs 3) KV-cache tail + eviction stats 4) decide rollback/fallback or routing fix.
infra-bot: [ALERT] 500-rate /generate us-west cluster: p95 latency spike -> 1.8s, error-rate 7%. Ticket created: INC-2026-184.
zack: sharing a quick-tail command for runtime logs:
```
# tail last 200 lines for service runtime
kubectl logs -n inference runtime-usw --since=10m | grep generate -n | tail -n 200
```
liam: Found repeated errors in the runtime: "kv cache miss -> eviction race" stack snippet: `runtime/kv/cache.go:238 handleGet -> nil pointer` — attaching trimmed lines to bridge.
sandeep: KV cache metrics: eviction count jumped 3x at 20:08, mem pressure looks elevated. I can try clearing a problematic shard to see if it stabilizes.
nora: Any quick rollback plan? Can we route to a warm fallback model variant for critical customers?
maya: Yes we have a compatible smaller variant (gpt-small-qual) available in the region. If triage confirms cache-induced corruption, we'll roll traffic to that variant and keep verifying.
zack: If we need to force a cache flush, use this admin command (use carefully): `curl -XPOST https://admin.usw.internal/cache/flush?shard=3 -H "Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN_TOKEN"`
oncall-bot: Escalation created: INC-2026-184 -> Priority P1. Pager duty rotation notified: oncall@redwood.
liam: I'm on the bridge, tailing logs now and correlating request IDs.
sandeep: Starting cache shard 3 flush now (will report results in 30s).
maya: Good call. If flush reduces 500s, we'll keep on fallback traffic for 5m then re-evaluate.
nora: Joining bridge now.
maya: Thanks all. Keep messages short here and post relevant snippets or request IDs. I'll update the incident and ops board. :thumbsup:
